standard_prerequisites.name: The functoriality of the module of differentials for a morphism of ringed spaces, together with the description of the pullback of a module on stalks
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Both are invoked inside the counted proof (source lines 5341-5342, 5354-5361) as pointers to a lemma of this chapter and a result of another chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Identifies the maps of the sequence with the maps appearing in the algebraic exact sequence.

standard_prerequisites.name: The compatibility of the formation of differentials with taking stalks
standard_prerequisites.source_reference: Invoked inside the counted proof at source line 5347 as a pointer to a lemma of this chapter
standard_prerequisites.use: Turns the sequence of sheaves into a sequence of modules over the local rings of the stalks.

core_obligations: Pass to stalks: taking induced maps on stalks and using the compatibility of differentials with stalks, the proof obtains a sequence of modules over the local rings at a point of the source (proof lines 5346-5353)

Identify the maps: the maps of this sequence are the same as those in the algebraic exact sequence for a composition of ring maps, because the maps in the sheaf level sequence are characterised by their effect on differentials of local sections and the stalk of a pullback is computed by tensoring with one (proof lines 5354-5361)
Conclude: hence the sequence of sheaves is exact, which is the statement (proof lines 5361-5362)
proof_roadmap: 取 x ∈ X 处各茎上的诱导映射，并用微分与取茎相容（本章引理）得 O_{X,x} ⊗_{O_{Y,f(x)}} Ω_{O_{Y,f(x)}/O_{S,gf(x)}} → Ω_{O_{X,x}/O_{S,gf(x)}} → Ω_{O_{X,x}/O_{Y,f(x)}} → 0。
再由 functoriality 引理对映射的刻画与 (f^*s)_x = s_x ⊗ 1（跨章引理），该序列的映射与交换代数的正合列中相同，故正合。
difficulty_reason: The counted statement gives the canonical exact sequence of modules of differentials associated to a composition of morphisms of ringed spaces, with the maps coming from functoriality (author lemma at source lines 5334-5343, label lemma-triangle-differentials). The proof (source lines 5345-5362) passes to stalks, where the sequence becomes the algebraic exact sequence for a composition of ring maps, and identifies the maps by comparing the characterisation of the functoriality maps with the description of the stalk of a pullback (proof lines 5346-5361). The identification of the two sets of maps on stalks is the content. H2.
